id: Pembaruan otomatis: Putar memberi tahu saat ada versi baru dan memasangnya sendiri. Bisa dimatikan di Pengaturan.
Tombol media di keyboard dan panel media Windows bekerja, juga saat Putar diminimalkan.
Dua subtitle sekaligus, gaya subtitle, pilihan pengodean, dan pencarian subtitle online lewat OpenSubtitles dengan kunci API.
Alamat halaman situs video lewat yt-dlp, yang bisa dipasang dari Pengaturan.
Semua pintasan bisa diubah. Playlist diingat, ada pustaka folder, penanda, visualisasi musik, mode kecil, dan aksi setelah playlist selesai.
Folder DVD dan Blu-ray diputar langsung ke judul utama, tanpa menu.
Laporan galat disimpan hanya di komputer Anda, dan bisa Anda salin ke Komunitas.
Perbaikan: isi panel kanan tidak lagi tertimpa video pada label panjang, dan ukuran serta posisi subtitle tersimpan saat Putar dibuka lagi.
Pengguna 0.1.0 perlu memasang versi ini secara manual sekali, karena pembaruan otomatis baru ada mulai 1.0.0.
Kode sumber mpv dan FFmpeg yang dipakai (LGPL) terlampir di rilis ini.
en: Automatic updates: Putar tells you when a new version is out and installs it. You can turn this off in Settings.
Keyboard media keys and the Windows media panel work, also while Putar is minimized.
Two subtitles at once, subtitle styling, encoding choice, and online subtitle search through OpenSubtitles with an API key.
Video site page addresses through yt-dlp, which you can install from Settings.
Every shortcut can be changed. The playlist is remembered, and there is a folder library, bookmarks, music visualization, mini mode, and an action for when the playlist ends.
DVD and Blu-ray folders play straight to the main title, without menus.
Error reports stay on your computer, and you can copy them to the Community.
Fixes: long labels no longer let the video cover the right panel, and subtitle size and position are kept when Putar reopens.
Users of 0.1.0 need to install this version by hand once, because automatic updates start with 1.0.0.
The source code of the mpv and FFmpeg versions used (LGPL) is attached to this release.
